comments: This isn't the first time someone requested this feature. I don't think #1571 covers this, though.

@skyline75489 thanks for your reply.

I don't mean the dropdown menu. I want to say the right context menu of "Title bar".
Yeah I know. See https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/issues/3158#issuecomment-774434692 for similar requests.

Yep, this is a good idea. We can only really do "duplicate tab" - the terminal has no concept of what the last command in each tab was. But "Duplicate Tab" is definitely a good idea. I've linked this up with #1912. Thanks!

:tada:This issue was addressed in #9388, which has now been successfully released as `Windows Terminal Preview v1.8.1032.0`.:tada:

review_comments: This is a nit, but mind renaming the function above to something like "_DuplicateCurrentTab"? I feel like somebody will get confused between `_DuplicateTab(tab)` and `_DuplicateTabViewItem()` at some point.
A stupid question: if a tab is not focused, can it be duplicated?
I kinda want see a image of gif demonstrating this feature. There's no image so I can only guess how it will behave based on the method name 😅

Here I just renamed the method for duplicating the current tab (in the `TerminalPage` terminology, current tab is called focused tab, since it is returned by GetFocusedTabIndex).

The addition in the rest of the code is to allow duplication of the tab which is not necessarily the current tab, by clicking on "Duplicate Tab" in the TabView's context menu.

For anyone curious, this is the icon:
![Segoe MDL2 Asset Icon](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11050425/110154862-a19fba00-7d99-11eb-8a53-ad3a64ef46da.png)

Chromium edge uses this:
![Edge Icon](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11050425/110155031-d7dd3980-7d99-11eb-8bbc-911ae181855c.png)

but that's not a Segoe MDL2 Asset.

I wish there was a better icon but I couldn't find one. Seems like Segoe MDL2 Assets don't include any tab-related icons.
Yeah. Didn't find anything less confusing
